summary: Search tab bug fix verified end-to-end on the web preview. Empty state renders 'Search for music', query 'love' returns 21 real results from HARDCODED_TRACKS (case-insensitive title/artist match), gibberish 'zzzqqq' shows 'No results found', clear button resets to empty state, tapping 'Love in This Club (Rehab Flip)' starts playback via useAudioPlayer with the MiniPlayer at the bottom (title + timer advancing 0:03 -> 0:05). Home tab regression PASS - folders (100k Stream Hit Club, July/June/May Releases, etc.) still list correctly and MiniPlayer persists across tabs. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av (see react_native_issues).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the expo-audio and expo-video packages to replace the required functionality.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/contexts/AudioPlayerContext.web.tsx and native context

Non-route files inside /app/frontend/app/ (components/MiniPlayer.tsx, components/AddToPlaylistModal.tsx, constants/*.ts, context/AudioContext.tsx, contexts/AudioPlayerContext.tsx, contexts/AudioPlayerContext.web.tsx, utils/playlistStorage.ts) trigger warnings 'Route "..." is missing the required default export'. Expo Router is treating these as routes. Move non-route files outside app/ (e.g. to /app/frontend/src/) or rename/exclude them so they are not registered as routes.

Deprecation warnings: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated (use textShadow); 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow); Image style.resizeMode is deprecated (use props.resizeMode); props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Fix in shared UI components / MiniPlayer / cover art image.

Console error: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' Likely coming from a legacy lib (react-native-safe-area-context or expo-av). Not blocking, but should be tracked.

action_items: None required for the Search fix itself - user bug is resolved.
Migrate expo-av -> expo-audio (and expo-video if used) before SDK 54 removes it.

Move non-route files (components/, constants/, contexts/, context/, utils/) out of the /app/frontend/app/ folder (or add them to Expo Router ignore) to stop the 'missing default export' route warnings.
Replace deprecated style props: textShadow*/shadow*/resizeMode/pointerEvents with the new equivalents.
critical_code_review_comments: search.tsx implementation is clean: local filter via useMemo, correct empty vs no-results branching, playTrack(track, filteredTracks) mirrors collection screen so queue reflects search context. No testIDs on the search input, clear button, or track rows - low-priority accessibility/testing gap.
seed_data_creation: None - app uses hardcoded local data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully client-side (no /api backend). Web preview uses AudioPlayerContext.web.tsx via expo-av HTML5 audio. Search filters HARDCODED_TRACKS by title+artist case-insensitively. No testIDs anywhere - use text selectors (e.g. get_by_placeholder('Search tracks or artists...'), get_by_text). Mobile viewport 390x844 works. Playback needs ~2-4s to start streaming from b-cdn.net URLs.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: previous /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/search.tsx was fetching from a non-existent backend /api/tracks endpoint (this is a standalone hardcoded app), so filteredTracks was always empty -> 'No results found'. Fix (already applied by main agent): replaced with useMemo filter over HARDCODED_TRACKS and playback via useAudioPlayer().playTrack(track, filteredTracks). Verified working in web preview.
